messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "treatment program includes diet, exercise, and weight control"
set: ["treatment program includes diet, exercise, and weight control", "your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, and blood tests", "include diet, exercise, weight control, and special medical care", "treatment may include weight control", "your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, medical tests, and special medical care", "weight control", "complete treatment program", "hypertension treatment program", "total treatment program for ADHD", "complete program of treatment for hypertension", "includes prescription and over-the-counter medicines", "includes vitamins", "hyperactivity and impulse control", "weight loss and weight management", "is only part of complete treatment program", "includes dietary changes and taking calcium and vitamin supplements"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
